pages.title: CatDoku
pages.creator: QiGame
pages.description: Place cats on the grid in CatDoku. Every row, column, and color region needs exactly one cat, and cats cannot touch. Use the clues to narrow down where each cat can go. Work through the handmade puzzles to unlock Daily Challenge and Survival, and use a hint when you get stuck.

pages.title: Chaindrop
pages.creator: L8A
pages.description: Drop a ball into a field of glowing pegs in Chaindrop. Each hit raises your multiplier, so look for a drop that can bounce several times before leaving the board. Meet the score target with the balls you have, then choose an upgrade for the next round. Bombs clear nearby pegs, while green pegs add a ball.

pages.title: Ocean Blaze
pages.creator: Aishermeow
pages.description: Race a speedboat through checkpoints in Ocean Blaze. Steer through the turns and keep an eye on hazards as you work through each lap. Watch the boost meter and save the extra speed for a stretch where you have room to use it.

pages.title: VegaMix2 Wild West
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Solve match-three boards as you explore Lostown in VegaMix2 Wild West. The story takes you past a ruined bridge and a ghost train as the heroes investigate mysterious silver and search for an outlaw named Dirty Nick. Work through the puzzles to see what happened in the town.

pages.title: Fallling Jewels
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Move falling gems left or right in Fallling Jewels and rotate their arrangement before dropping them into place. Aim to make matches that clear room for the next set. Use explosive rewards when obstacles block the part of the board you need, and keep building your score.

pages.title: Bubble Blasters
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Trap enemies in bubbles in Bubble Blasters as you work through side-scrolling stages. Look for keys and hidden rewards while avoiding traps, and earn stars as you clear levels. Choose a hero and upgrade your gear before taking on the next stage.

pages.title: Pet Doctor Business Tycoon-Pet care game
pages.creator: minigame
pages.description: Treat pets in Pet Doctor Business Tycoon-Pet care game. Examine animals such as cats, dogs, and rabbits, check their heartbeats, and clean wounds. Follow the treatment steps for each case, including surgeries when the game calls for them.

pages.title: Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Build a boutique in Tailor Stylist: Fashion Diary and create outfits from the fabric up. Choose the materials, work on the garment, and put together the finished look. Try different combinations as you develop your style and take on more design work.

pages.title: Number Rush
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Steer a number through the course in Number Rush. Absorb values equal to or smaller than yours and dodge the obstacles along the way. A collision with a higher number ends the run. Grow as much as you can before hitting the wall that stands between you and the treasure chest.

pages.title: SNAKES
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide several snakes through a grid in SNAKES. Use the layout and obstacles to work out where each snake can go, then fill every open tile to solve the level. Plan the routes together, since a turn that works for one snake can leave too little room for another.

pages.title: Sort Tiles
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Clear the board in Sort Tiles by tapping pieces to move them in the direction of their arrows. Check which paths are already open and move those tiles first so others have room to slide. Clear the last tile to reveal the picture underneath.

pages.title: Suitable Outfit Dressup
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Style an anime character in Suitable Outfit Dressup. Browse different clothing and hairstyles, then try them together to see which combinations suit the character. Change one piece at a time or put together a different look from the start.

pages.title: Coffee Craze - Sorting Game
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Sort cups by drink type in Coffee Craze - Sorting Game. Look at which cups you can move and where they can go before rearranging them. A useful move brings matching drinks together while leaving room to work on the other groups.

pages.title: Block Blaster Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Rotate and arrange pieces in Block Blaster Puzzle to fill rows or columns. A complete line clears, giving you more space for upcoming pieces. Play for a high score or work toward the current level's target when you want a specific objective.

pages.title: Detective - Logic Puzzles
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Investigate cases in Detective - Logic Puzzles by comparing clues and ruling out suspects. Use deduction to see which details can be true together and which possibilities the evidence rules out. Follow each story until you can identify the person responsible.

pages.title: Elite Chess
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play a standard game of chess in Elite Chess with one of three time settings. Choose a clock that suits how quickly you want to play, then look for threats and opportunities as the pieces develop. Work up through the ranks from Bronze toward Diamond.

pages.title: Level Up Mutants
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Combine monsters in Level Up Mutants to create stronger creatures, including dinosaurs. Build up your mutants and send them against opponents to see how your choices work in battle. Try different combinations as you look for a stronger lineup.

pages.title: Royal Family Tree
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Complete generations of royalty in Royal Family Tree. Read the clues and place each king, queen, prince, or princess where the family relationships make sense. Compare generations before filling a spot, since one person's placement can narrow down where several others belong.

pages.title: Hexa Sort
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Place stacks of hexagonal tiles in Hexa Sort. Set matching colors beside each other so they can gather into taller stacks. Check which color is showing on each pile before making a placement and leave space for the next tiles.

pages.title: From Nerd To School Popular
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Guide a high school student through a makeover in From Nerd To School Popular. Choose new styles as the story takes the student through school challenges. Follow the character's growing confidence and see how the makeover fits into the changes at school.

pages.title: Supermarket Manager Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stock the shelves and sell groceries in Supermarket Manager Simulator. Keep track of what the store needs, from snack foods to meat and produce. Put goods out where shoppers can find them and switch between restocking and sales as you run the supermarket.

pages.title: Tiny Cars
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Control traffic from above in Tiny Cars. Click vehicles to manage their movement and look for conflicts before they reach an intersection. Work through 50 stages in settings such as squares and highways, then revisit the layouts with more demanding traffic.

pages.title: Moto Stunt Biker
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Ride across motocross courses in Moto Stunt Biker. Balance the bike over obstacles, slow down when the landing is tight, and use Shift for nitro when you have room. Earn cash to unlock and improve motorcycles as you clear the levels.

pages.title: Geometry Subzero
pages.creator: Greenlight
pages.description: Guide a little frozen monster through snowy courses in Geometry Subzero. Click or tap to clear spikes as the character moves forward. Try characters such as a turtle, penguin, or seal and watch the route closely so you can react before reaching the next hazard.

pages.title: Sort Games Challenge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Choose a sorting mode and beat its deadline in Sort Games Challenge. Look at what the current puzzle asks you to group before moving pieces. Complete the mission before time runs out and switch modes when you want a different sorting task.

pages.title: Number Collector: Brainteaser
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: Link neighboring number blocks in Number Collector: Brainteaser so their sum equals the target. Plan the chain before you start, since each block has to touch the next. Use a hint when you cannot see a combination and watch for bonuses that add time.

pages.title: Prinxy Winterella
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create a winter-ball makeup look in Prinxy Winterella. Try icy shades and fantasy-inspired details, then compare how the colors look together on each face. Change the makeup to suit the style you want for the ball.

pages.title: Offroad Moto Mania
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Race a dirt bike over rough terrain in Offroad Moto Mania. Steer with the arrows or WASD and brake with Space before a difficult stretch. Switch camera views for a different perspective on the track, or reset the bike if you get stuck.

pages.title: Prado Car Parking Games Sim
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive into the marked space in Prado Car Parking Games Sim. Use WASD to steer around the parking plaza and line up the car before pulling in. Look for fuel pickups if you need to keep driving, and try the different parking modes.

pages.title: Crazy Clash - Merge Defense
pages.creator: CrazyFire
pages.description: Merge identical soldiers in Crazy Clash - Merge Defense to upgrade your army. Drag two matching units together, then decide where the stronger unit can help the defense. Keep improving the force as invading enemies approach.

pages.title: Hammer Raytrace 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Redirect a beam in Hammer Raytrace 3D so it reaches the enemy. Use mirrors, glass, and other elements to change how the light travels around obstacles. Follow the route from its source and adjust whichever piece is sending the beam away from its target.

pages.title: Vacuum Rage
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Steer a runaway vacuum cleaner in Vacuum Rage. Move it from side to side as it swallows rubbish and anything else in the route, including people, trees, and houses. Try to sweep up as much as you can as the scene clears in front of you.

pages.title: Wear the helmet
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Ride a scooter through traffic hazards in Wear the helmet. Move up or down to stay clear of obstacles and keep the ride going. Use W and S, the arrow keys, or touch controls, then see how long you can stay on the road.

pages.title: Little Lily St.Patricks Day Photo Shoot
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Get Lily ready for a St. Patrick's Day photo shoot in Little Lily St.Patricks Day Photo Shoot. Browse her wardrobe for a green outfit, then pick accessories that fit the look. Try a few combinations before settling on what she will wear for the photos.

pages.title: Rolling Blocks
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Flip colored blocks across a white canvas in Rolling Blocks. Each turn paints part of the surface, so plan the direction of your moves around the pattern you need to copy. Look at what a flip will color before rolling the block again.

pages.title: Ghost Walker
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Hunt bandit leaders as a ninja in Ghost Walker. Use slow motion to line up movement and decide whether to fight the guards or slip past them. The route you take is up to you, but you still have to face the bosses.

pages.title: Cursed Treasure 1.5
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Protect the Overlord's last three gems in Cursed Treasure 1.5. Build and upgrade towers, cast spells, and learn skills to stop attackers from carrying the gems away. Adjust your defenses as ninjas, angels, and lizard riders approach along the routes.

pages.title: Runner Garden 3D
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Fill your basket with flowers in Runner Garden 3D. Steer left or right to collect them, then jump or slide to get past blocks and barriers. Stay on the path and gather enough flowers to complete the level without crashing.

pages.title: Alien World
pages.creator: Skorit Games
pages.description: Pilot a ship against alien forces in Alien World. Shoot through enemies, upgrade the ship, and take on bosses as you advance through the campaign. The mission is to find a new home for civilization, and hostile ships stand in the way.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 10
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Race across New York City in Uphill Rush 10, starting in a yellow cab. Unlock other rides such as scooters, horses, and hovercraft as you play through 20 levels. Upgrade your vehicles to improve your times and aim for three stars.

pages.title: Mr Gunslinger-shooting games
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Face a group of zombies as a lone gunman in Mr Gunslinger-shooting games. Watch where they are approaching and fire before they reach you. Try the different gun battle modes and adjust your position as the next enemies move in.

pages.title: Number Crush Mania
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Match three tiles with the same number in Number Crush Mania to merge them into a higher value. Larger numbers earn more points as you keep combining pieces. There is no timer, so you can check what each match leaves on the board before making the next move.

pages.title: Helicopter Escape
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Fire from a helicopter in Helicopter Escape and help the hostage get away. Aim your rifle at the pursuers as they come into view. Keep your attention on the targets that are closest to catching the person you are trying to save.

pages.title: Poke.io
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Chase other fighters in Poke.io and hit them with your weapon. Pick up what defeated opponents leave behind, and keep an eye on the top scorers as you try to overtake them. Watch the space around you when you move in for a strike.

pages.title: Gunner
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Tap to take shots at opponents in Gunner. Work your way higher through the encounters and spend coins on stronger weapons or different skins. Check the blacklist for special enemies and decide which target to take on next.

pages.title: Baby Penguin Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose a penguin picture in Baby Penguin Coloring and color it with the pencils. Change the pencil size when you move from a large area to a small detail. Save the picture when you are happy with the finished penguin.

pages.title: MineWorld Horror The Mansion
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search a mansion in MineWorld Horror The Mansion after two officers and a medic disappear there. Watch for the living dead as you explore the blocky rooms and shoot when you need to get through. Keep track of your ammunition while looking for a way out.

pages.title: BFF Summer Bash 2020
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get Mia and Bella ready for their summer party in BFF Summer Bash 2020. Choose makeup for each friend, then find outfits that go with their looks. Try matching the two styles or give each friend a different take on the party theme.

pages.title: Babushka Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Color one of eight nesting doll pictures in Babushka Coloring. Pick your own colors for the patterns and details, then use the camera button to download the finished image. Switch to another doll when you want to try a different palette.

pages.title: Square Puzzle
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Fit differently shaped pieces together to make a square in Square Puzzle. Look at which pieces can fill the corners and how their edges meet. Adjust the arrangement until the pieces cover the whole square.

pages.title: Cars Card Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Flip cards to find matching cars in Cars Card Memory. Remember where each vehicle appeared if your first two picks differ, then use that information to clear the pairs. Each board has a time limit and the layouts get harder as you advance.

pages.title: Brand New Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Pick a car picture in Brand New Cars Jigsaw and choose a board with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. There are twelve images to assemble. Use the outlines of the vehicles and nearby background details to see which pieces should join.

pages.title: Big Sumo Must Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Make the larger wrestler jump over the smaller one in Big Sumo Must Jump. Click at the right moment to clear the other wrestler as he comes toward you. Each successful jump earns points, so watch the distance before you time the next leap.

pages.title: Pixel Craft Match 3
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Match blocks of the same color in groups of three or more in Pixel Craft Match 3. Keep clearing blocks to raise your score and watch the gauge on the left. Make another match before it drops too far and ends the round.

pages.title: Cube Battle Royale
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight zombies and other creatures in Cube Battle Royale. Decode devices across the city and get out of each area within twenty seconds. Finish all the missions to bring in a rescue helicopter. Play alone or team up with a friend and revive each other when needed.

pages.title: Antarctica Princess
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Search the castle for missing accessories in Antarctica Princess. Look for items such as makeup, ribbons, shoes, and bags that the princess needs for a winter party. Check each scene for small details so you can find everything in time.

pages.title: Daily Baby Care
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Look after three different babies in Daily Baby Care. Check what each baby needs and use the items the game makes available for that part of the routine. Move from one baby to the next as you work through the babysitting tasks.

pages.title: Cars Driver
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Choose a vehicle and a map in Cars Driver. Use WASD to steer around the area and get a feel for how the car handles. Return to the menu to try a different combination when you want another route or vehicle.

pages.title: Mountain Trip Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble pictures of vacation vehicles in mountain settings in Mountain Trip Jigsaw. Choose from twelve images and solve one with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Look for details such as roof luggage, trailers, and mountain ridges to help place neighboring pieces.

pages.title: The Running Sheep
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Steer a sheep down an endless forest path in The Running Sheep. Use the mouse or arrow keys to move around obstacles. Look at the route ahead and change course before the sheep reaches a barrier, then see how long you can keep it running.

pages.title: Fashion Girls Nail Salon
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Work on a manicure in Fashion Girls Nail Salon. Choose the style you want for the nails and follow the salon's steps to put the design together. Try different looks as you work through the nail art activity.

pages.title: Toy Car
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Explore a city or enter a race in Toy Car. Free driving gives you time to look around and pick up coins, while the race puts you up against other cars on the way to the finish. Try different car models and use the brake when a turn calls for it.

pages.title: Cadillac CT4 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six images of the Cadillac CT4 in Cadillac CT4 Puzzle. Pick a picture and choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the car's outline and details in the background to connect pieces when several look alike.

pages.title: Worms Zone a Slithery Snake
pages.creator: Peaky Muzzle
pages.description: Guide a worm around the arena in Worms Zone a Slithery Snake and eat the food you find to grow. Use the mouse to steer and press Space for speed when you need it. Watch where other worms are headed before following a trail of food.

pages.title: Pixel Challenge
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Jump across platforms in Pixel Challenge. Aim for the white platforms and stay clear of spikes, fragile blocks, and red blocks that can end an attempt. Use the arrow keys to move and judge where you will land before trying the next jump.

pages.title: GunHit
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Shoot moving targets in GunHit and leave the flying bombs alone. Time each shot as an object crosses your line of fire. Play for prize money on your own or take on a friend in the two-player mode.

pages.title: Folding Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Unfold pieces to cover an empty area in Folding Block Puzzle. Drag a block in the direction you want it to open and check what space the new section fills. Plan the order of folds so one piece does not take room another one needs.

pages.title: German Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Put together twelve pictures of German cars in German Cars Jigsaw. Choose an image and solve it with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Look for lines in the bodywork or background that continue from one piece to the next.

pages.title: Lightbulb Physics
pages.creator: FreeGames.org
pages.description: Remove blocks to bring a lightbulb into contact with its power block in Lightbulb Physics. Think about what will fall or tilt before you tap a support. The 60 levels get harder as the arrangements change, so watch where the bulb will land.

pages.title: Knock Balls
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fire a cannon at stacks in Knock Balls. Look for a point where one hit can send several blocks tumbling instead of knocking down just one. Adjust your aim after the stack shifts and work through the levels.

pages.title: Pixel Soldier Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find matching pictures in Pixel Soldier Memory. Choose a level and turn over tiles to see what is underneath. Remember where each soldier picture appeared when two tiles do not match, then use that information to clear the remaining pairs.

pages.title: Super Balls
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Aim balls at bricks in Super Balls and use rebounds to reach more than one part of the board. Look for an angle that sends the balls toward bricks you cannot hit directly. Destroy every brick to finish each of the 90 levels.

pages.title: EG Highway Racer
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Drive through traffic in EG Highway Racer. Look for openings between vehicles and leave room to steer when the traffic closes in. Try One Way, Two Way, Time Attack, or Speed Bomb and aim for a better score in each mode.

pages.title: King Fish Online
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Shoot fish to earn rewards in King Fish Online. Take on quests, use the proceeds to improve your weapons, and try to catch more fish on later trips. You can also raise fish you catch to generate money.

pages.title: Christmas Hurly Burly
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Use the elves' maps to find Santa's missing presents in Christmas Hurly Burly. Work out where gifts belong using the clues for each row and column. Mark lines you have solved to keep track of your progress across the 30 levels.

pages.title: Pixel Jump
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Jump from floor to floor in Pixel Jump and try to survive as long as possible. Check where enemies are moving before leaving the current level. You can keep jumping as often as you need, but touching an enemy ends the run.

pages.title: Princess Tailor Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Make three dresses in Princess Tailor Shop. Work with the princess in her new shop and follow the steps for each design. Move from one garment to the next to see how the different dresses take shape.

pages.title: io Games Wormate
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Grow a worm in io Games Wormate and try to become the largest in the arena. Pick a nickname before entering and steer toward food as you move. Keep an eye on other worms while you look for space to grow.

pages.title: Falling Ball
pages.creator: c2gamesstudio
pages.description: Switch the center ball's color in Falling Ball so it can catch the next one coming down. Check the falling ball before you change and time the switch for when it reaches the center. A catch in the wrong color ends the run.

pages.title: Princess New Look Haircut
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Rapunzel a new hairstyle in Princess New Look Haircut. Work with her preference for strawberry blonde and try a style that suits the color. Use the salon tools and controls to shape the look before finishing the appointment.

pages.title: Princess Prom Photoshoot
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Get a princess ready for a date in Princess Prom Photoshoot. Choose a hairstyle and outfit as part of a full makeover. Click through the available items and try a few combinations before deciding what she should wear.

pages.title: Deliver Pro
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Drag boxes into trucks of the matching color in Deliver Pro. Check the color as each box appears and send it to the correct truck before moving on to the next one. Keep up with the deliveries for as long as you can in the endless round.

pages.title: Puffy Boy Run
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Guide a boy through traffic in Puffy Boy Run. Use the arrow keys to dodge obstacles as the route takes him from busy streets into places like the subway and forest. Watch for a change in hazards whenever the setting shifts.

pages.title: 10x10 Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Drag blocks onto a ten-by-ten grid in 10x10 Block Puzzle. Fill an entire row or column to clear it and make room for more pieces. Check what gaps a placement leaves so the next awkward shape still has somewhere to fit.

pages.title: Yellow Flappy HTML5
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Tap to keep a yellow bird flying in Yellow Flappy HTML5. Rise when you need to clear an obstacle and let the bird drop when the next opening is lower. Time the taps carefully and see how far you can get without hitting anything.

pages.title: Golf Solitaire: a funny card game
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Clear the layout in Golf Solitaire: a funny card game by removing cards one rank higher or lower than the visible card. Suit does not affect the move. Draw from the covered deck when you need a new starting card, and aim to clear the whole grid.

pages.title: Felicia's Day
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Choose what Felicia does on a lovely day in Felicia's Day. Click to explore the scene and follow the activities that interest you, such as picking flowers. See where the day takes her as you make choices along the way.
